verdict.rationale: A government immigration service could plausibly publish a documented public API, for example for application status or processing-times data, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes web pages, online accounts and interactive checkers (eligibility questionnaires, a processing-times checker, status checks), with no documented public API for programmatic use. Web-based self-service tools are a related but different feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
